about_the_game:
Man from hell. Exodus. -  is a spectacular 3D first-person shooter with elements of survival horror and stealth action with a gripping plot.

Game World

Web. The Kingdom of Darkness. A jungle of steel and concrete, where people have lived for generations. Hundreds of kilometers of corridors and galleries, where death awaits in the darkness, dimly gleaming with the metal of armor. And the House, the safest place, where the enemy, regularly testing people for strength, has not yet managed to break through.

What is the web? There is no information, only hypotheses and assumptions. How did people end up here, in this gloomy black underworld? Why did they come? And is it possible to get out?.. There is no answer.

 You take on the role of a fighter of a special operations unit, ready to risk his life and go through all the horrors of the "Underworld" in order to achieve his goal - to save the people of the community from total destruction.

 Throughout the story, you will have to solve various tasks and break through to the surface, fighting various enemies.

Features

- An original plot based on the book series "PEACE - HOME" by Denis Vladimirovich Shabalov, a Russian writer working in the post-apocalyptic genre.

- Hand-crafted atmospheric locations that contribute to deep immersion in the game world.

- Various opponents and allies.

- A variety of firearms on which you can install attachments.

- Well-developed shooting and damage system.

- Convenient inventory and equipment system.

- Weapon and armor damage system. The more worn out the weapon, the lower the shooting accuracy. Armor wear affects the protective characteristics. (can be disabled in the game settings)

- A well-developed system of game settings with which each individual player can individually customize the game for a comfortable passage.

- Survival system: hunger, thirst, endurance. (can be disabled in the game settings)

- System of repair and crafting items on the workbench.

- Excellent optimization.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit processor and Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit) operating system
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel Core i5-7500
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 560 with 4GB VRAM / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: It is recommended to install this game on a system SSD.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit processor and Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit) operating system
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 / Intel Core i7 8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 40 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: It is recommended to install this game on a system SSD.
